purpose: Test the prospective hypothesis that periodic Python cyclic garbage collection contributes to the same-request NRx >30 ms host/GPU-event tail clustered near release 2740–2762 in Confirm43/44. Instrument collection duration and disable automatic GC only in the intervention, with an explicit collection before every timed epoch in both arms.

decision_at_stake.pass: If both GC-on runs have a >30 ms NRx violation overlapping a measured collection, both GC-off runs have no NRx violations or collections, and safety gates pass, qualify a new separate experiment testing whether the GC-off path can satisfy an 8 ms NRx service contract. Do not infer that 8 ms is already safe.
decision_at_stake.fail: If any required GC-on or GC-off arm contradicts the hypothesis, stop this route without extra seeds; a shorter NRx bound requires another concrete mechanism before GPU qualification.

if_both_outcomes_lead_to_same_action: Cancel if the result would not change whether the GC-off short-bound route is developed.
early_stop_rule: Analyze after every completed arm. If that arm fails its frozen hypothesis, input, contract, or safety gate, stop before the remaining arms because full PASS is then impossible; preserve the partial report and data.
single_question_rule: Only automatic Python cyclic-GC behavior is varied; the 8 ms admission contract is a separate later decision.
strongest_realistic_opponent: Same initialized cap80 MPS NeuralRx and cap20 background worker, same trace and bounded contract, with automatic GC enabled versus disabled in ABBA order.

execution.operational_requalification: 200 conventional-only releases with zero deadline misses

measurement_sources.worker: matching _worker.json and _background.json:host, slurm_job_id, visible_sm_count, mps_active_thread_percentage, completed_units
measurement_sources.safety: controller JSON:endpoint_timeouts, conv_bound_violations, background_budget_violations, background_release_crossings, background_faults, duplicate_commits, fallback_calendar_final, endpoint_final

evidence_grade: A local GC contribution only if the ABBA frozen hypothesis and all control gates pass; otherwise C diagnostic. Neither grade qualifies an 8 ms bound or top-conference novelty.
interpretation_limit: The two GC-on/GC-off pairs are a mechanistic diagnostic, not a proof of a WCET bound or proof that GC is the only tail source. Preserve all run data and report failure of any gate without reclassifying prior Confirm43/44 failures. A GC-off success still requires maintenance/lifecycle and fault-injection checks before claiming a conditional deadline guarantee.
